baseline_identity.source: strict actual running version from GET /api/version

first_shipped_fixed_release_threshold.label: PROPOSED - frozen at release; not a live claim until release freeze

rules: running 0.6.224 or older -> existing whole-DMG path (full)
unknown, malformed, ambiguous or prerelease identity -> full fail-closed via existing whole-DMG path
known RELEASED fixed-or-later running baseline AND existing delta capability dict -> delta eligible
capability is the existing delta dict; Hub emits it only after validating and rescanning installed bytes
no new wire field, route or status
